_about: Hand-written cases for eval/support_judge.py. Each one rewrites a real claim from memos/*.trace.json against the same cited passage. 'paraphrase' keeps the meaning in different words, so a good check accepts it. 'reversal' reuses the passage's own words but says something the passage doesn't, so a good check rejects it. Written once before any judge was run, and not edited after seeing results.
